# Fixtures: official GSAP skills examples

Copied verbatim from the `examples/` directory of
[greensock/gsap-skills](https://github.com/greensock/gsap-skills) at commit
`aed9cfd3277740755f6bfc1155c7aa645403b760`.

MIT licensed, Copyright (c) 2026 GreenSock. See `src/data/skills/LICENSE`.

These are GreenSock's own reference implementations of the patterns the skills
describe, which makes them the right regression fixture for
`validate_gsap_code`: if the validator reports an error on this code, the
validator is wrong.
